priorityList: Cast Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger
Cast Tiger Palm with: less than 4 Chi, less than 2 stacks of Blackout Kick!, about to cap energy, AND not during Zenith
Cast Spinning Crane Kick with less than 4 seconds remaining on Dance of Chi-Ji, NOT at 2 stacks of Blackout Kick!, and NOT during Zenith
Cast Tiger Palm if any of the above are available and you do not have enough Chi
Cast Blackout Kick with Blackout Kick! OR Zenith active
Cast Spinning Crane Kick with Zenith AND more than 3 Chi
Cast Spinning Crane Kick with a Dance of Chi-Ji proc
--- WoWhead Opener (GENERIC - not filtered by hero spec) ---
Cast Zenith with potions, racials, and trinkets. Stat buffs go before Zenith.
Cast Fists of Fury if Rising Sun Kick reset your Fists of Fury cooldown.
--- WoWhead Rotation (GENERIC - not filtered by hero spec, may contain irrelevant rules) ---
Cast Tiger Palm if less than 4 Chi, less than 2 stacks of Combo Breaker, AND about to cap energy
Cast Spinning Crane Kick with less than 4 seconds remaining on Dance of Chi-Ji AND not at 2 stacks of Combo Breaker
Cast Tiger Palm if not enough Chi for the above
Cast Blackout Kick with Combo Breaker or Zenith active
Cast Spinning Crane Kick with Dance of Chi-Ji
